name: Mirri
description: Mirri is a cat warrior of the skyship Weatherlight, trained by Multani and Gerrard's friend, who dies protecting him; a cat of the same name appears in Sami's story in Edge of Eternities.

description_citations.text: Vanguard Series: card flavor text (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

summary.text: Mirri is a cat warrior of the skyship Weatherlight, trained by Multani and Gerrard's friend, who dies protecting him; a cat of the same name appears in Sami's story in Edge of Eternities.

citations.text: "Mirri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Mirri was born in an unknown forest, banished for having two different eye colors, and became a student of Multani, where she befriended Gerrard and Rofellos and fell in love with Gerrard.

citations.text: "Mirri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mirri", section "Time with Multani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She joined the Weatherlight crew with Gerrard and Rofellos, left with Gerrard after Rofellos was killed, and rejoined three years later when Gerrard asked her to be his Lieutenant.

citations.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Rath she searched the Skyshroud for Gerrard with Hanna, and the two came to an understanding.

citations.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Curiosity (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: In the Stronghold she exposed a shapeshifter disguised as Sisay, and she took Selenia's blow meant for Crovax and was gravely wounded.

citations.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She later attacked Crovax when she saw him sabotaging the Weatherlight, and both fell into Volrath's Garden, where she let him kill her so that Gerrard would save himself.

citations.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Volrath's Gardens", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Gerrard later recalled the wreath she had laid for her kin, and the Weatherlight crew held a memorial for her.

citations.text: Revive (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In Edge of Eternities a cat named Mirri weftwalked away from Sami and vanished, and Sami's search for her cost them most of their crew.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.
"Sami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Sami found her alive in a stasis cask on Infinite Guideline Station, frozen in time.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

status.text: The Weatherlight cat warrior Mirri was killed by Crovax on Rath, while Sami's cat Mirri was recovered alive and is with Sami.

citations.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mirri rejoins Gerrard aboard the Weatherlight as his unofficial first mate.
timeline.quote: she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate

citation.text: Mirri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri and Rofellos to hone spellcasting alongside physical discipline.
timeline.quote: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri, and Rofellos to hone their spellcasting in tandem with more physical disciplines

citation.text: Multani (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri resists the urge to kill Ertai as he boasts.
timeline.quote: Mirri's hackles rose as Ertai continued expounding his virtues.

citation.text: Abjure (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri lays a wreath for her fallen kin.
timeline.quote: "I place this wreath for you, my kin. Even in death, you give me strength to avenge you."

citation.text: Blossoming Wreath (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard trains under Multani and befriends Rofellos and Mirri.
timeline.quote: Here he befriended the elf Rofellos and the cat -warrior Mirri .

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Rofellos and Mirri join Sisay's Weatherlight crew after Gerrard loses a wager.
timeline.quote: with Gerrard having lost a tavern wager over a contest of knife-throwing against her

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians attack Crovax's Estate hunting Bloodline subjects; Rofellos is killed and Gerrard quits the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: During this battle, Rofellos was killed, which was too much for Gerrard.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri is born in an unknown forest and banished for having two different eye colors.
timeline.quote: Mirri was born in an unknown forest where she was banished for having two different eye colors

citation.text: "Mirri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri becomes a student of Multani and befriends Gerrard and Rofellos, falling in love with Gerrard.
timeline.quote: she eventually became a student of Multani and a friend to Gerrard Capashen and Rofellos

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Time with Multani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On a trade mission to the Chitr'in, Keilic and Gerrard come to blows and Mirri throws herself between them.
timeline.quote: only stopped when Mirri threw herself between them, seeking to protect Gerrard

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Time with Multani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri walks the Spirit Path, defeats her spirit beast and chooses Gerrard, receiving a prophecy that her path will lead Gerrard to his death.
timeline.quote: she fought her beast and defeated it, choosing Gerrard in the process

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Time with Multani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri joins the Weatherlight crew with Rofellos and Gerrard to find the Legacy artifacts.
timeline.quote: Mirri joined the crew of the Skyship Weatherlight in its quest to find the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Rofellos is killed, Gerrard leaves the ship and Mirri goes with him, then travels to Llanowar to tell Rofellos's family.
timeline.quote: Rofellos was killed in the attack on Crovax's Estate

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Three years later Gerrard asks Mirri to be his Lieutenant and she rejoins the crew to rescue Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Mirri both were instrumental in stopping the rampaging monster

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath, Greven il-Vec takes the Legacy artifacts and Gerrard falls overboard.
timeline.quote: they were unable to stop Greven il -Vec from taking the Legacy artifacts

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri and Hanna search the Skyshroud for Gerrard; Hanna saves Mirri from a shapeshifter and they come to an understanding.
timeline.quote: Hanna saved Mirri from, earning her Mirri's respect

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elves capture Mirri and Hanna, but Gerrard is proclaimed the Korvecdal, leading to an alliance with Eladamri's rebels.
timeline.quote: leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Stronghold, Mirri's sense of smell exposes a shapeshifting minion of Volrath disguised as Sisay.
timeline.quote: Her sense of smell saved the crew from one of Volrath 's shapeshifting minions

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri dives in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and is gravely wounded; Crovax slays Selenia and Tahngarth carries both back to the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri dove in front of him to deflect one of Selenia's strikes.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri sees Crovax sabotaging the Weatherlight's sails, attacks him, and both tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden.
timeline.quote: She attacked Crovax, causing both of them to tumble overboard into Volrath's Garden .

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri lets Crovax kill her so that Gerrard will save himself, fulfilling the spirit beast's prophecy.
timeline.quote: Mirri let Crovax kill her so that Gerrard would save himself.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna and Mirri face slivers that protect each other.
timeline.quote: We must learn how they protect each other.

citation.text: Armor Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri apologizes to Hanna for thinking her a burden.
timeline.quote: I thought you a burden, and you saved my life.

citation.text: Gallantry (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, who had imprisoned Mirri and Hanna, releases them after Gerrard explains.
timeline.quote: He was brought to the home of the elvish lord Eladamri

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the ship.
timeline.quote: Hanna took charge of the ship with Mirri 's support and landed the ship in the forest below.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna defeats a shapeshifter and bonds with Mirri, then both are taken prisoner by the Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: through ingenuity, Hanna managed to defeat the monster.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri is startled by Volrath's scentless apparition.
timeline.quote: Mirri was startled by Volrath's apparition

citation.text: Intruder Alarm (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri leaps silently and a guard dies.
timeline.quote: Mirri leapt quickly and silently.

citation.text: Leap (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard studies the globe and realizes it shows Dominaria.
timeline.quote: This is Dominaria!

citation.text: Invasion Plans (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax strikes down Selenia, who shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: Crovax's curse had been fulfilled: he had killed the love of his life and had been damned because of it.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after she follows him on deck and they fall into Volrath's garden.
timeline.quote: where Crovax then proceeded to kill the cat warrior.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Descent into madness". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selenia hurt Mirri badly and tore wounds in Crovax's soul that will not close.
timeline.quote: Selenia had hurt Mirri terribly

citation.text: Convalescence (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri follows Crovax's skulking form despite exhaustion.
timeline.quote: she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

citation.text: Curiosity (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay recruits Gerrard and his friends as Weatherlight crew after a knife-throwing contest.
timeline.quote: recruited the companions as crew on the Weatherlight as payment for a bet

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Mirri leave the Weatherlight crew, blaming the Legacy for Rofellos's death.
timeline.quote: Gerrard, with Mirri in tow, left the crew of the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter in the Skyshroud forest.
timeline.quote: She disarms the monster and slices it open

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri kills a guard as the crew docks at the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Mirri slew a guard who had noticed them before he had time to scream.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Selenia wounds Mirri on the bridge to the Dream Halls.
timeline.quote: The angel turns her attack toward the cat warrior, slicing her deep across the belly.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth returns mutilated, carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth reappears, emerging from the Stronghold mutilated by Volrath's tortures and carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax ambushes Mirri in the lower deck of the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Mirri is ambushed from behind somewhere in the lower deck by her former ally, who says it is his destiny for him to kill her.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri takes Crovax overboard with her into the Gardens.
timeline.quote: she is dropped overboard by Crovax, but grabs his wrist and takes him down with her

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Keilic allows the Spirit Way to rip out his throat after Mirri's choice, in flashback.
timeline.quote: Keilic accepted Mirri's choice and allowed his throat to be ripped out by the beast.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax bites Mirri's neck.
timeline.quote: He wrests free and tells her that she will join him to rule Rath, before biting into her neck.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leaves Mirri behind to die.
timeline.quote: departs with the ship, leaving the cat warrior behind to die

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Mirri's Tale" ( Liz Holliday )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Vuel starts his war against his brother, Multani goes into hiding, leaving his students to think he is dead.
timeline.quote: Multani went into hiding

citation.text: "Multani", section "Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard recalls the living wreath Mirri laid for her kin.
timeline.quote: recalling the living wreath Mirri laid for her dead kin.

citation.text: Revive (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri after going insane and leaving the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri had followed him, which had led to her death at his hands.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A sudden flood carries off the Weatherlight with warriors on boats during Mirri's memorial.
timeline.quote: A memorial service for Mirri and the other dead is interrupted by a sudden flood that brings in a band of warriors on boats and that starts to carry off the Weatherlight.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In an alternate timeline Mirri the Cursed subjugates the en-Kor as her slave race.
timeline.quote: subjugated the en -Kor as her personal slave race.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri lives for a while in Llanowar, where she meets Rofellos.
timeline.quote: This is where she met Rofellos .

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Mirri on Rath.
timeline.quote: Crovax kills Mirri.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In an alternate reality seen in Planar Chaos, Mirri strikes the killing blow against Selenia, becomes the vampiric Mirri the Cursed, and is abandoned on Rath.
timeline.quote: it was Mirri who struck the killing blow instead of Crovax

citation.text: "Mirri", section "Alternate reality". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter, then she and Mirri are captured by Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: they were soon captured by Skyshroud elves.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Dream Halls Crovax strikes down the real Selenia, her shattered form entering him and making him a vampire.
timeline.quote: In a moment of deep regret, Crovax struck her down

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri sacrifices herself fighting Crovax so Gerrard can escape.
timeline.quote: she sacrificed herself, allowing Gerrard to live.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew defeats the first Aboroth in Llanowar by traditional means.
timeline.quote: The first one was defeated traditionally

citation.text: "Elemental", section "Aboroths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax senses Mirri is unready for the curse and flees weeping.
timeline.quote: Crovax sensed that Mirri wasn't ready for the curse taking hold of her.

citation.text: Keen Sense (Planar Chaos, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri warns that the next person to tell her to relax by a fire is dead.
timeline.quote: The next one who tells me to relax and curl up by a fire is dead.

citation.text: Bogardan Firefiend (Planechase, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri follows Crovax's skulking form, suspicious.
timeline.quote: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

citation.text: Curiosity (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri weftwalks away from Sami and vanishes, and Sami is determined to find her.
timeline.quote: Mirri weftwalked—and vanished.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami suspects the Metalman sent them to limit his losses, but Tan insists on staying with Sami and reports a cat-like sound near the mining sheds.
timeline.quote: Captain, I think it's a cat.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 2" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami asks about Mirri, showing a picture.
timeline.quote: Sami produces a picture of Mirri.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami refuses to give up the stone because the Metalman is their hope of finding Mirri.
timeline.quote: then he wouldn't fix our ship. And then who'd look for Mirri?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami reveals they are looking for their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: I look for my cat.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami explains that Mirri weftwalked on Uthros and vanished.
timeline.quote: She weftwalked.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya offers to help look for the cat.
timeline.quote: I'll help you look for the cat,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami promises to return for Mirri.
timeline.quote: I won't be leaving Mirri behind. I'll come back for her.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami opens a stasis cask and finds their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: "Mirri?" Sami gasps.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami realizes Mirri weftwalked into a stasis cask on a similar ship and was frozen in time.
timeline.quote: She weftwalked away from the Seriema when she was startled and went to a ship that looked almost like the Seriema and landed in a stasis cask.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mirri yowls and weftwalks away from the approaching eld.
timeline.quote: Mirri yowls and vanishes. Weftwalks away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk calms Sami's panic and Sami decides what to do next.
timeline.quote: I can't decide what to do next. I need you to do it for me.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami opens the stasis cask and Mirri trots out beside the Endstone.
timeline.quote: A cat trots out of the dark.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami holds Mirri, relieved that one thing is all right.
timeline.quote: Mirri is still here.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: After bad luck including Mirri's disappearance, Sami lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.
timeline.quote: After a run of bad luck (including the disappearance of their beloved cat, Mirri), they lost most of their crew to more lucrative outfits.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mirri weftwalks off the ship and Sami's search costs them most of their crew, leaving Tannuk.
timeline.quote: only Tannuk staying on

citation.text: "Sami", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew takes the Endstone to Infinite Guideline Station, uses the station to warp enemies into the Wurmwall, and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills a shapeshifter mimicking Selenia; the real Selenia ambushes the Weatherlight crew and wounds Mirri.
timeline.quote: who wounded Mirri on a narrow bridge

citation.text: "Dream Halls", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A battle at the station; Sami's group warps enemies into the Wurmwall and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: Sami also recovered their missing cat Mirri from a stasis cask aboard the station

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rofellos studies with Gerrard and Mirri under Multani, then joins the Weatherlight crew with Mirri.
timeline.quote: Rofellos and Mirri offered to come along as well

citation.text: "Rofellos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Selenia in the Stronghold and is cursed to become a vampire.
timeline.quote: in the instant that he killed her, a terrible curse befell Crovax, turning him into a vampire

citation.text: "Selenia", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vampiric Mirri slaughters the forest's cats; Shikka and Talack flee.
timeline.quote: Shikka is forced to flee for her life with Talack

citation.text: "Shikka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax and Mirri fall from the ship into the gardens, where Crovax drinks Mirri's blood.
timeline.quote: allowing him to drink her blood

citation.text: "Volrath's Gardens", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mirri tells the dying Gerrard to flee; the ship escapes while Crovax finishes Mirri and enters the Stronghold.
